title: Repair on my way
description: Mending is hard to get if you don't want to...villagers
body:
**Simple mod that allow you to repair stuff**

In this mod, you can craft <repair tablet> and <repair ticket> to repair your items
For now there are 4 tier and 1 upgrade
  - copper: 50 durability
  - iron: 200 durability
  - gold: 250 durability
  - diamond: 750 durability
  - percentage upgrade: 33% durability
